content.text: It's not unusual for an 8-year-old to wake at night now and then. Waking every night is worth some attention, though. Summer light, a busy head, or a later bedtime can all cause it. Tonight, try a calm 10-minute wind-down chat before lights out, where Ada can say whatever is on their mind. If they wake at 2am, keep it short and boring: walk them back to bed, give a quick reassurance, and skip the screens and snacks.
